p: righteousness: For then God declares himself just, when he preserves his as he has promised.
net that they have laid privily: Preserve me from the crafty counsels and subtle practise of my enemies.
hand I commit my spirit: He desires God not only to take care of him in this life, but that his soul may be saved after this life.
trust in the LORD: This affection should be in all God's children to hate whatever is not grounded on a sure trust in God, as deceitful and vain.
large room: Largeness signifies comfort, as straitness, sorrow and peril.
eye is consumed with grief: Meaning, that his sorrow and torment had continued a great while.
reproach among all mine enemies: My enemies had drawn all men to their part against me, even my chief friends.
many: They who were in authority condemned me as a wicked doer.
Thou art my God: I had this testimony of conscience, that you would defend my innocence.
times are in thy hand: Whatever changes come, you govern them by your providence.
silent in the grave: Let death destroy them to the intent that they may hurt no more.
hast laid up for them that: The treasures of God's mercy are always laid up in store for his children, even at all times they do not enjoy them.
secret of thy presence from the: That is, in a place where they will have your comfort, and be hid safely from the enemies pride.
strong city: Meaning, there was no city strong enough to preserve him, as the defence of God's favour.
haste: And so by my rashness and infidelity deserved to have been forsaken.
strengthen your heart: Be constant in your calling, and God will confirm you with heavenly strength.
